articles.summary: TORONTO, Canada – March 17, 2026 – Fury Gold Mines Limited (TSX and NYSE American: FURY) (“Fury” or the “Company”) announces initial results from the Phase 1 13,000-metre exploration drill program at the Eau Claire Gold project, located in the Eeyou Istchee Territory in the James Bay Region of Northern Quebec. Phase 1 drilling was focussed on expanding resources along […]
articles.title: Fury Intercepts 11.74 g/t Gold over 6.63 Metres from Infill Drilling at Eau Claire; Commences Phase 2 Drilling - Fury Gold Mines Limited
